title: BAG (Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen) - pand layer
license: Dutch government open data (no restriction for this kind of derived use)
notes: Real footprint + bouwjaar (construction year) for every building currently standing. Ingested by scripts/fetch-bag.mjs into public/data/hoorn-bag.json. Does not cover demolished buildings or anything before the cadastral era.

title: Bestuurlijke Gebieden - Gemeentegebied (municipal boundary)
license: Dutch government open data
notes: Used to filter BAG/basemap pulls to the actual Hoorn municipal polygon (gemeente code 0405), not just a bounding box.

title: BRT Achtergrondkaart (national topographic basemap)
license: Dutch government open data
notes: Present-day-only reference basemap, stitched from WMTS tiles by scripts/fetch-basemap.mjs into public/data/hoorn-basemap.jpg. Not historical; era-appropriate ground textures are expected to come from phase 3 instead.

title: Topotijdreis / TOPraster (historical topographic map series)
license: Dutch government open data (TOPraster GeoTIFFs via PDOK)
notes: Already georeferenced in EPSG:28992 - the preferred source for anything in its date range. No manual control-point work needed. Not yet ingested by a script.
